Part 2&3 人物 PEOPLE

Describe a person you know who has a successful business

描述你认识的一个做生意成功的人

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a person you know who has a successful business

  • Who this person is (这个人是谁)
  • How you got to know him/her (你是怎么认识他/她的)
  • Why and how he/she started the business (他/她为什么以及如何开始做这个生意)
  • What business he/she does (他/她做的是什么生意)
  • And explain why you think the business is successful (并解释为什么你觉得这个生意是成功的)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a person you know who has a successful business

I'd like to talk about my uncle, my mother's sister's husband, who runs a very successful business. I've known him my whole life, since he's part of the family, and we see him regularly at family gatherings. As for how I got to know him, well, he's been around since I was a child, so I've always known him as a warm and hardworking person. I remember he used to visit our home during festivals, and he always seemed busy, often taking phone calls about work even during dinner. To be honest, I don't know all the details of his business, but I know he started it from scratch about fifteen years ago, with just a small team. Over the years, it has grown into a company that employs dozens of people, and he now owns several branches. The reason I think his business is successful is that it has survived and grown for so long, which is not easy in such a competitive market. On top of that, he's clearly earned the trust of his customers, because his company keeps getting repeat orders. Looking back, I really admire his determination. He started with almost nothing and built something solid through years of hard work, and that's what I find most impressive about him.

讲姨丈，从小认识、逢年过节常见面；约十五年前白手起家，如今公司雇了几十人、开了多家分店；成功在于经营多年不倒、赢得客户信任、有回头客，令人佩服他的坚持。

Q2Why do some people start their own business?

There are several reasons why people start their own business. Firstly, many people want independence, because they're tired of working for someone else and want to control their own schedule. Secondly, some are attracted by the potential for higher income, since a successful business can earn far more than a salary. Of course, there's also the desire to pursue a personal passion, which can be a strong motivator.

创业原因多样：想要独立自主、不受雇于人；追求更高收入；以及想实现个人热情。

Q3Should governments provide financial support to start-ups?

I think governments should provide some financial support to start-ups, although it needs to be done carefully. The main reason is that new businesses create jobs and drive innovation, which benefits the whole economy. However, support shouldn't be given blindly, because many start-ups fail, and public money needs to be used wisely. So I'd say targeted support, like tax breaks or low-interest loans, is the best approach.

政府应提供一定支持但要谨慎：新企业创造就业、推动创新，但很多会失败，公共资金要花得明智；定向支持如减税、低息贷款最合适。

Q4Do most people prefer shopping at big stores or small stores?

Generally speaking, I think most people prefer big stores for everyday shopping, mainly because they offer lower prices and a wider range of products. That said, small stores still have their appeal, especially for things like fresh food or personalised service, where you can build a relationship with the owner. So I'd say it depends on what people are buying, but for convenience, big stores usually win.

日常购物多数人偏好大店，价格低、选择多；但小店在生鲜和个性化服务上有优势；取决于买什么，论便利大店通常胜出。

Q5What makes a business successful?

In my view, several factors contribute to a successful business. Firstly, understanding what customers actually need is essential, because a business that solves a real problem will always find buyers. Secondly, good management matters a lot, since even a great product can fail without proper planning and financial control. On top of that, I think adaptability is crucial, because markets change quickly, and businesses that can't adjust tend to fall behind.

成功要素：真正理解客户需求、解决实际问题；良好管理、合理规划与财务控制；以及适应市场变化的灵活性。

Q6What makes a business fail?

I think the most common reason businesses fail is poor financial management, because many owners run out of cash before their business becomes profitable. Another factor is failing to adapt, since consumer habits change quickly, and a business that ignores new trends will lose customers. Also, some businesses fail simply because there isn't enough demand for what they offer, no matter how hard the owners work.

失败主因：财务管理不善、盈利前就耗尽资金；不能适应消费习惯变化；以及产品本身缺乏足够需求。
